bugs.error_message: anatomy.md entries silently disappeared after unrelated file writes (google-play-publishing.skill, startup-free-traffic.skill)
bugs.root_cause: parseAnatomy() only matched entries ending in '(~N tok)'. Any other size label, e.g. '(~5.1K zip)', failed the regex and was skipped. post-write.js rewrites the whole file from the parsed map, so every unparsed entry was deleted on the next write anywhere in the repo.
bugs.fix: Added fallback patterns for arbitrary size labels and for entries with no label, storing the original text as entry.suffix; serializeAnatomy() emits it verbatim so the round-trip is lossless.

bugs.error_message: anatomy.md grew a section '## ../../../tmp/claude-0/.../scratchpad/' indexing a file outside the repo
bugs.root_cause: The hook guarded against .wolf/ paths but not against paths outside the project root. path.relative() returns a '../..' string for those, which was then used directly as an anatomy section key.
bugs.fix: Added isInsideProject() in shared.js and an early exit in post-write.js for any file outside the project root.

bugs.error_message: Skills present on disk (avoid-ai-writing, startup-free-traffic) were never listed in anatomy.md, despite the header claiming a recent scan
bugs.root_cause: No scanner existed. Entries were only ever added by post-write, so files arriving via git clone or checkout were never indexed, while the header stamped 'Last scanned: <now>' on every single-file write and looked authoritative.
bugs.fix: Added a bounded additive scan at SessionStart (walkProject + buildAnatomyEntry, 5000-file/3s cap, ~90ms on this repo) that indexes files missing from anatomy. It never prunes, since anatomy legitimately holds paths absent from a given checkout such as gitignored _private/. post-write now preserves the real scan timestamp instead of restamping it.

bugs.error_message: After `openwolf update` to 2.0.1, every Write/Edit crashed the post-write hook: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND '.wolf/hooks/symbol-extractor.js'
bugs.root_cause: Upstream bug in openwolf 2.0.1: both init.js and update.js copy a hardcoded 10-file hook list that omits symbol-extractor.js, while post-write.js imports it at module load. Any 2.0.1 install or upgrade leaves post-write dead, so anatomy, memory, session tracking and auto bug detection all stop silently.
bugs.fix: Copied symbol-extractor.js from the installed package into .wolf/hooks/. Re-run this copy after any future `openwolf update` until upstream fixes the list.

bugs.error_message: The 2.0.1 migration imported 87 of 89 anatomy entries; google-play-publishing.skill and startup-free-traffic.skill were dropped from anatomy-index.json
bugs.root_cause: Same lossy regex as bug-004, still present upstream in 2.0.1's parseAnatomy. It is now more damaging: anatomy.md is rendered from the store, so an entry missed at import is deleted from the index on the next write rather than merely being skipped.
bugs.fix: Local patch to parseAnatomy in .wolf/hooks/anatomy-store.js adding a fallback branch for entries whose size label is not '(~N tok)'; re-imported the two lost entries into the store with token counts from a real scan. Marked LOCAL PATCH — `openwolf update` will overwrite it.

bugs.error_message: Stop hook repeated 'ACTION REQUIRED: N files were modified this session but no semantic summary was written to memory.md' on every turn, immediately after summaries were written
bugs.root_cause: countSemanticEntries() matched rows by a '| YYYY-MM-DD' prefix, but memory.md rows are '| HH:MM | ... |' — the format OPENWOLF.md documents and the hooks themselves append. The count was therefore always 0 and the reminder was unsatisfiable: writing the requested summary could never clear it. Present in 1.0.4 and unchanged in 2.0.1.
bugs.fix: LOCAL PATCH in countSemanticEntries: track the '## Session: YYYY-MM-DD' header and count today's non-mechanical '| HH:MM |' rows, keeping the date-prefixed form working. Verified 12 entries counted vs 0 upstream, and the Stop hook now stays quiet.
